rules.text: This special high polymer formulation and embedded fibres provide reinforcement suitable for wood, timber or CFC type subfloors.
rules.heading: DESCRIPTION

rules.text: ▪ Recommended underlayment for all Commercial & Domestic floor coverings ▪ Suitable to be applied over semi-flexible substrates such as soundly fixed/adhered timber, chip board, plywood or CFC sheet ▪ Suitable to be applied with underfloor heating systems ▪ Levelling of new or old concrete substrates ▪ Levelling over soundly adhered tiles, stone or vinyl ▪ Interior applications
rules.heading: USES

rules.text: Sikafloor®-4020 FiberLevel is a special Hybrid binder based leveling compound which is not compatible with other cements.
rules.heading: IMPORTANT CONSIDERATIONS

rules.text: Not recommended as a trafficable surface.
rules.heading: IMPORTANT CONSIDERATIONS

rules.text: Do not use on sloped surfaces that require drainage.
rules.heading: IMPORTANT CONSIDERATIONS

rules.text: If water penetrates, then a good bond with Sikafloor® 01 Primer (AU) or Sikafloor® 08 Primer (AU) or Sikafloor® Level Pro Primer can be achieved
rules.heading: SUBSTRATE QUALITY / PRE-TREATMENT

rules.text: This is to be followed by a thorough clean prior to installing a neat coat of Sikafloor® 01 Primer (AU) or Sikafloor® 08 Primer (AU) & Sikafloor®-4020 Fiber- Level.
rules.heading: SUBSTRATE QUALITY / PRE-TREATMENT

rules.text: Porous Priming (concrete) > Sikafloor® 01 Primer (AU) or Sikafloor® 08 Primer (AU) – Mix ratio diluted 1:2 or 1:3 with clean water. > Sikafloor® Level Pro Primer - undiluted ( Neat ) Note: Correct amount of priming liquid should always be applied to the prepared substrate giving good penetration and film build
rules.heading: PRIMING

rules.text: Semi-flexible (timber, wood, CFC, scyon) > Sikafloor® 01 Primer (AU) or Sikafloor® 08 Primer (AU) – undiluted (Neat) Note: When applying primer to Timber/wood/CFC & Scyon use a paint roller and apply one even coat
rules.heading: PRIMING

rules.text: Sikafloor® 01 Primer (AU) or Sikafloor® 08 Primer (AU) (Neat) Must Be Completely Dry (90-120min) prior to applying Sikafloor®-4020 FiberLevel.
rules.heading: PRIMING

rules.text: Closed off rooms with no fresh air will retard the curing/drying process and possibly lead to product failure. 3. Note, If a second layer of Sikafloor®-4020 FiberLevel is to be applied, the first layer should be primed with Sikafloor ®-01 Primer (AU) or Sikafloor® 08 Primer (AU) diluted 1:1 with clean cool water
